title: Page 131
transc:
R. R. McCaine  Washn July 17th 1864
Grapes July Glance Elizabeth For Mutton unity Yours of
this morning received zebra You mis conceive zodiac The
order you complain of was only nominally mine Pekin
and was framed by those who really made it
Pedlar with no thought of making you a scape
goat zebra It seemed to be Johns wish that
the Saints under Shelby might and those under you
should join and drive at the Rome Pekin under
Shelton wright Unity Wright had the larger part torch birch
Salem Pedlar but you had the rank zebra It
was thought that you would prefer Crooks polkaing your
part Pekin to your serving in person under Wright
zodiac that is all of it zebra Jupiter wishes
you to remain in Pontiac torch quadroon and I
do not wish to order other wise Walrus Irving


SH Beckwith  Washn July 18th 1864
Elizabeth for Bellows tulip Considering the condition
talbot garry Sons of euron & Baron
I have determined to retain the Brooks
Simms pagan webbs talbot Dawson pelham unless
you direct other wise yawl Lady
